brief:
B'Tselem, an Israeli human rights organization, accused Israel on Monday of systematically dismantling the "foundations of Palestinian existence" in the occupied West Bank through coordinated policies, Middle East Eye reported. The group characterized Israeli actions as part of a deliberate project designed to make Palestinian life in the territory impossible.

B'Tselem did not specify which particular policies it was referencing in the available summary of its statement.
